description: Socle partagé utilisé par les 3 axes : kill-switches de config, vocabulaire d'occasion + weather_band (consommé par ranking_model FEAT-002 et context_agent FEAT-004), conftest isolant la suite des flags (chemin fallback par défaut, review-F2), et package rag vide pour FEAT-003. Aucun câblage dans les agents — modules standalone testés. Les tests existants restent verts (chemin fallback actif par défaut via le conftest, indépendant des artefacts committés). Dépendances : aucune (foundation).
steps: Ajouter à backend/app/core/config.py (classe Settings) : `ranking_enabled: bool = True` et `contextual_rag_enabled: bool = True` (défaut True, review-F14). Pas d'autre changement.

Créer backend/app/services/occasions.py : `OCCASION_CATEGORIES = ['mariage','soiree','travail','casual_quotidien','sport','plage','voyage','ceremonie']` (8 catégories, design § Vocabulaire). `WEATHER_BANDS = {'froid': (<14), 'modere': (14..24), 'chaud': (>=24)}` cohérents avec seasons.COLD_BELOW_C=14/HOT_FROM_C=24. `weather_band(temperature: float|None) -> str|None` (retourne None si temperature None). `parse_occasion_rules(text: str|None) -> dict` avec matching PAR TOKEN (mots entiers via regex split sur non-mots incluant accents, review-F3) — PAS par sous-chaîne ; table FR/EN du design (mariage/wedding→mariage formality5 dress_code 'tenue de cérémonie' ; church/funeral/baptême/ceremonie/communion→ceremonie ; soirée/party/disco/club→soiree ; travail/bureau/meeting/entretien→travail ; sport/gym/fitness/running→sport ; plage/beach/mer/baignade/pool→plage ; voyage/trip/vacances/airport/avion→voyage ; aucun match ou text None→casual_quotidien). Évaluation en cascade (premier match gagne), fallback casual_quotidien. Retourne {'occasion_category','formality','dress_code'} — toujours une catégorie du vocabulaire (jamais None). ATTENTION faux positif review-F3 : 'mer' doit matcher le TOKEN 'mer' pas la sous-chaîne (sinon 'commercial'→plage) ; qualifier les mots-clés courts.

Créer backend/tests/conftest.py : fixture autouse (portée fonction) qui `monkeypatch.setenv('RANKING_ENABLED','false')`, `setenv('CONTEXTUAL_RAG_ENABLED','false')`, `setenv('LLM_PROVIDER','none')`, `from app.core.config import get_settings; get_settings.cache_clear()`, yield, puis `get_settings.cache_clear()` au teardown (review-F2). Isole la suite du .env dev (LLM_PROVIDER=none empêche appels réseau dans test_context_agent).
Créer backend/app/rag/__init__.py (vide) pour le package context_retrieval (FEAT-003).

Créer backend/tests/test_occasions.py : parse_occasion_rules mapping injectif (un texte→une catégorie), table FR/EN, fallback casual_quotidien pour None et texte sans match, PAS de faux positif — assert parse_occasion_rules('je vais au centre commercial') == 'casual_quotidien' (pas 'plage', review-F3) ; weather_band bornes (13→'froid', 14→'modere', 24→'chaud', 30→'chaud', None→None).
acceptance_criteria: `cd backend ; python -m pytest tests/test_occasions.py -q` passe et couvre le mapping injectif, le fallback casual_quotidien, l'absence de faux positif 'commercial'→plage, et les bornes weather_band.

`cd backend ; python -m pytest tests/test_recommendation_agent.py tests/test_context_agent.py tests/test_llm_agent.py tests/test_compatibility_model.py -q` passe (17 tests existants verts — chemin fallback actif par défaut via le nouveau conftest).
`cd backend ; python -c "import app.rag; from app.core.config import get_settings; s=get_settings(); assert s.ranking_enabled is True and s.contextual_rag_enabled is True"` réussit (défauts True).
verification: cd backend ; python -m pytest tests/test_recommendation_agent.py tests/test_context_agent.py tests/test_llm_agent.py -q
cd backend ; python -c "import app.rag; from app.core.config import get_settings; s=get_settings(); assert s.ranking_enabled is True and s.contextual_rag_enabled is True"
findings: FEAT-001 socle landed (no agent wiring yet — flags NOT read by any agent, per design). Introduces: (1) backend/app/core/config.py: Settings fields ranking_enabled: bool = True and contextual_rag_enabled: bool = True (default True, review-F14); read via get_settings().ranking_enabled / .contextual_rag_enabled; FEAT-002 ranking_model.score_outfit consumes ranking_enabled, FEAT-006 orchestrator consumes contextual_rag_enabled. (2) backend/app/services/occasions.py exports: OCCASION_CATEGORIES (list[str] of 8: mariage, soiree, travail, casual_quotidien, sport, plage, voyage, ceremonie — indexes ctx_vec in FEAT-002); WEATHER_BANDS (dict name -> (min_inclusive, max_exclusive) in degC; keys froid/modere/chaud; bounds reuse seasons.COLD_BELOW_C=14.0 and HOT_FROM_C=24.0 imported, not hardcoded, for guaranteed coherence); weather_band(temperature: float or None) -> str or None (<14 froid, 14..<24 modere, >=24 chaud, None -> None); parse_occasion_rules(text: str or None) -> dict returning occasion_category, formality, dress_code. IMPORTANT: parse_occasion_rules returns a DICT, not a string — the FEAT-001 acceptance '== casual_quotidien' was an abbreviation; tests assert result['occasion_category']. Downstream (FEAT-004 ContextAgent, FEAT-002 ranking_model) read result['occasion_category'] (always in OCCASION_CATEGORIES, never None, safe as ctx_vec key), result['formality'] (int 1..5), result['dress_code'] (str or None). Token matching (whole-word; re split on non-word incl accents, review-F3) NOT substring; cascade first-match-wins per design table; fallback casual_quotidien (formality 2, dress_code None) for None or no-match. Token caveat: all keywords are single words; 'nightclub' does NOT match 'club' (whole-word). (3) backend/tests/conftest.py: autouse fixture isolate_enrichment_flags sets env RANKING_ENABLED=false, CONTEXTUAL_RAG_ENABLED=false, LLM_PROVIDER=none then get_settings.cache_clear() at setup AND teardown (review-F2); mechanism is setenv + lru_cache clear (not patching app.core.config.get_settings, which does not propagate because modules bind the name at import); isolates suite from dev .env and forces fallback path so existing 17 tests stay byte-identical; to re-enable in a new test: monkeypatch.setenv('RANKING_ENABLED','true') + from app.core.config import get_settings; get_settings.cache_clear(). (4) backend/app/rag/__init__.py: package (docstring only); import app.rag works; FEAT-003 adds context_retrieval.py. (5) backend/tests/test_occasions.py: 35 tests covering vocab shape, FR/EN keyword->category, always-in-vocab invariant, casual_quotidien fallback, review-F3 'centre commercial' -> casual_quotidien (not plage) guard, and weather_band boundaries (13 froid, 14 modere, 24 chaud, 30 chaud, None None). Resolution notes: weather_band is DERIVED from temperature, never a kwarg (review-F1/F3) — orchestrator/recommendation_agent compute weather_band=occasions.weather_band(temperature) before ranking_model.context_vector(occasion_category, season, weather_band); parse_occasion_rules guarantees in-vocab occasion_category, so the real ctx_vec fallback trigger is season=None (design Fallback ctx_vec) — FEAT-002 implements 3 branches (occ|season|band -> occ|season|_any -> zeros(512)). Verification: pytest tests/test_occasions.py -q = 35 passed; 17 acceptance tests pass; python -c import app.rag + assert defaults True OK; full pytest tests -q = 170 passed, 13 skipped, 2 failed (PRE-EXISTING, UNRELATED: test_tryon_agent.py ModuleNotFoundError: No module named gradio_client — missing optional try-on dep, absent in baseline). No regression.
